usage: The word 運動員 (wan6 dung6 jyun4) is a noun used to describe a person who participates in sports professionally or competitively.
You can use 運動員 in both singular and plural contexts, for example, 該隊有很多優秀運動員 (The team has many excellent athletes).
運動員 can be combined with verbs like 訓練 (train) or 比賽 (compete) to describe actions related to athletes.
It is commonly used when talking about sports teams, competitions, or physical activities involving skilled sportspeople.
